title: Lunis Training catalogue entry: programme or module (v3, November 2026)
description: Fields at the top of each file in programmes/ and modules/. Written sections below the fields, in this order: Aim and Purpose; What It Covers (optional, programmes); Intended Audience (bullets); Learning Objectives (bullets); Syllabus (bullets, modules); Structure and Format; Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience; Materials (optional); Core Reading (bullets); Modules Intro (optional, programmes). Modules leaving Intended Audience, Prior Knowledge, Core Reading, level or deliveryFormat blank take them from their first programme.

id.description: Permanent sequential number, shared by programmes and modules. Never reused or changed. Also the page link: programme.html?id=<id>.

entryType.description: Programme (made up of linked modules) or Module (every standalone course and every programme module).

summary.description: One or two sentence teaser for cards.

clientType.description: Which of the five 'Training for' groups this entry appears under. One or more.

pillar.description: Exactly one pillar for each client type the entry carries, chosen from that client type's list in taxonomy/pillars.json. The validator checks the keys match clientType exactly.

topic.description: Free text subject label, e.g. 'Management & leadership fundamentals'.

tags.description: Short cross-cutting subject labels (crypto, AI, AML, MiCA ...). Used for search, the tag filter and Related training.

partOf.description: Modules only: the programme(s) this module belongs to and its module number in each. Programmes' module lists and module counts are built from these links automatically.

image.description: Filled automatically by the build when images/<id>.webp exists. Do not type by hand.

active.description: true = shown on the site; false = hidden everywhere, including inside programmes.

contentGaps.description: Internal flags for unconfirmed content. While non-empty, the page shows 'the full content is being finalised'.

businessFunction.description: KEPT FOR NOW, under review. Not shown on the site.

deliveryFormat.description: Required. How it is delivered; one or more.

durationValue.description: Required. Length as a number. For a programme, the total.

role.description: Carried over from October; pending review. Role groups (taxonomy/roles.json).

firmType.description: Carried over from October; pending review.

level.description: Required on programmes. Modules without a level take their programme's.

legacySlug.description: Internal: an old web address name, only where the file has been renamed since it was published, so old links still redirect.

hoursPerModule.description: Programmes only, optional: typical teaching hours per module ('c. 3 hrs per module'). Otherwise total hours / module count.

related.description: Optional: ids of programmes or modules shown under 'Go further'. If empty, the site falls back to entries sharing tags.

brochure.description: Filled automatically when brochures/<id>.pdf has been generated. Do not type by hand.

intro.description: Optional, programmes: the longer lead paragraph under the title (the brochure cover text). Falls back to summary.
